pages.title: Axiomatic Field Emitter
pages.text: A field emitter that projects not forces but rules - a small region where a chosen axiom holds or does not. It is built on a graviton emitter with an axiom fragment, and it feels like holding a principle.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Axiom theory showed that axioms can be distilled and edited. I mounted an axiom fragment on a graviton field emitter with transcendent metal, a horizon shard and a transfinite processor, and the emitter began projecting law instead of force.
